title: Remove the memory account service and link route, share one request parser, validate registrations once
description:
Two account services exist: `AccountsService` over a memory `TransactionStore` (`accounts/service.ts`, `store.ts`, `testing/memory-account-store.ts`) and `DurableAccountsService` over Virtuus files. Only the durable one runs. The `/v1/identities/link` route always answers 409. Six handlers each copy their own header lower-casing, body parsing and JSON response helpers with different size limits (1024, 12000, 20000, none). `caller()` re-validates the whole product registry on every request.

Scope:
- Delete `AccountsService`, `TransactionStore`, the memory store, the `link` route and the memory harness mode; make `AccountsApi` a standalone interface.
- One shared request parser and response helper in `accounts/request.ts`, used by the account, directory, BFF and identity handlers, with each handler's limit stated once.
- Validate registrations once at composition time; handlers accept the validated array.

Acceptance: `npm test` and all native suites pass; Lambda bundles and the client package still build; docs no longer mention the memory service or the link route.
